newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power to buy Colorado assets.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power to buy Colorado assets.

text.p: DENVER, Feb 28 (REUTER) - Montana Power Co said on Friday it agreed to buy the Vessels Energy's oil and gas assets in Colorado for $85 million.
The acquisition, Montana Power's largest ever, will be made through its oil and gas subsidiary, American Resources Co.
The assets are located in the Denver-Julesburg (D-J) Basin.
The acquisition will boost the company's annual hydrocarbon production in the D-J basin to 7,275 million cubic feet from 3,805 MMCF.
